## Observations from the first runs (at `a70c563`, hand-written, kept on re-run)

- Run history: 2 full runs, both 17/17 PASS (first run: read_file x2 before edit, turn 3 latency 17.5s). No AGENTS.md or prompt iterations were needed: 0 of the 3 allowed.
- No tool failures, no `run.warning` of any kind, no `context_trimmed`, no shell reads through `run_command`. The model used `repo_map`, `read_file`, `edit_file`, `run_tests` only; it ran tests with `run_tests`, as AGENTS.md says.
- Kill/resume: SIGKILL (`signal=SIGKILL`, `exit=null`) landed after the first `run.tool.succeeded` of turn 3. After the 5s lease TTL, `recoverWithReport()` returned `{"expired":1,"redispatched":1,"deadLettered":0}`; attempt 2 completed the turn. Turn 3 had 2 attempts, events from 2 distinct `attemptId`s, contiguous `seq`, unique tool-call ids.
- Event volume: turn 3 log held about 500 events for 4 provider requests (token deltas are logged individually).
- Narrow coverage: the model finished each turn in 3 to 5 requests, so the kill window is short (about 1s after send). The kill hit a tool boundary each time; the at-least-once case (side effect done, event not logged) was not exercised live. Models cooperate easily with this tiny task; it says nothing yet about long or ambiguous tasks.
- Guard mode `full_auto`: approval paths (`ask`, `auto_edit`) are not exercised until M5.
- The script is not covered by any `tsconfig` (same as other `scripts/*.ts`); it was checked once with an ad hoc `tsc` config using the repo base options and `types: ["bun"]`.
